observations: Photos show a removed vehicle drivetrain/engine assembly on a workshop floor, with many hoses/wiring harnesses disconnected.
The assembly appears to be an automatic transmission attached to an engine (gearbox casing visible at the bottom/side of the unit).
There is heavy grime/oxidation and some areas look worn; no clear readable ID plate/label is visible in the provided angles.
No clear photo shows the transmission model code, VIN tag, or any test/working status indicator.

claims.claim: American drive Gearbox for Ford Econoline E150 E250 E350 V8
claims.evidence: Photos show an engine+gearbox assembly but no readable Ford/vehicle fitment tag or transmission code to confirm it matches Econoline E150/E250/E350 V8.
No photo shows the transmission being tested (shift quality, fluid condition, diagnostic scan) or any standard/spec documentation.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission type/fitment (gear ratios, bellhousing/adapter, or E-series V8 variant mismatch). Photos don’t show the transmission code/part number.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the transmission ID/part number label or stamping (and/or the engine/transmission mating/bellhousing code) plus the Ford application details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used gearbox/assembly with unknown fitment risk (assume may not fit or may require parts).

risks.risk: Unknown condition (may be non-working, slipping, or missing internal parts) because there is no test evidence.
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (engage all gears, reverse, no abnormal noise) and/or a short diagnostic/bench test report.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: needs overhaul or may be faulty).

risks.risk: Missing components/harnesses/hoses (photos show many disconnected lines; could be missing sensors, cooler lines, or mounting hardware).
risks.proof: Photo checklist: show all included parts laid out (sensors, solenoids, cooler lines, linkage, mounting brackets) and confirm nothing is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Fluid leaks/damage from shipping or prior failure (grime/wear visible; no leak inspection shown).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the gearbox exterior for cracks/holes and a wipe-clean inspection after cleaning; include underside leak check video.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the gearbox/transmission ID plate or stamped part number (photo where the text is readable).
Video proof of operation: shift through gears (P/R/D/1/2/3 as applicable) and reverse engagement, with sound/no harsh slipping.
Photos of all included parts (sensors, wiring connectors, cooler lines, linkage, mounting brackets) laid out and counted.
Leak/condition proof: underside close-ups and a short post-clean inspection video.
response.reason: The photos show a used engine+gearbox assembly, but the key details needed to price confidently in Lagos (exact transmission code/fitment and working condition) are not readable or proven. Request the transmission ID/part number and a working test video before pricing.
